independent_geometry_check.method: Shapely 1.6.4.post2 polygon distance and intersects; no optimizer or PSDF backend used
independent_geometry_check.obstacle_source: All 17 RectangleRegion numeric bounds extracted from the maze branch of sim/simulation_mpc.py via AST
independent_geometry_check.footprint: Centered 0.15 m by 0.07 m rectangle rotated by each recorded heading
independent_geometry_check.pose_source: Initial pose from trial_results.csv plus all 243 post-control poses from trial_history_MPC_cc_ecs_rectangle_maze.csv

log_alignment.pose_sdf_row_i: Pre-control pose at t=i*dt; matches ECS solve_step=i+1, horizon_stage=0, time=i*dt
log_alignment.trial_history_row_i: Post-control pose at t=(i+1)*dt; its control, status, and solver time belong to ECS solve_step=i+1
log_alignment.correct_pose_join: trial_history[i] matches pose_sdf[i+1] for i=0..241; the final post-control pose exists only in trial_history

goal_distance_check.explanation: A* maps the requested goal into its grid-cell center; Robot._get_goal_position uses the final global-path node. The reported trial distance is therefore to the path endpoint and is correct for the current success checker. Both distances are below 0.02 m.
